content.value: The initial temperature of the billet was $1 0 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and rolling time for the first pass was 5 (10) seconds. For subsequent passes, the rolling time was proportional to the length of the product. Find out the final temperature of the rolled steel bar. The average specific heat of steel at high temperature is 0.166 kcal/kg0C.
